```{r lib, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(ariadne)
library(anansi)
library(curatedMetagenomicData)
library(mia)
library(miaViz)
```

```{r}
graph <- ariadne()
```

# Functional annotation

## ChocoPhlAn

```{r}
# Load gene family experiment
genes <- curatedMetagenomicData(
    "SankaranarayananK_2015.gene_families", dryrun = FALSE
)

genes <- genes[[1]]

# Keep only unstratified gene families
genes <- genes[!grepl("|", rownames(genes), fixed = TRUE), ]

# Print experiment
genes
```

```{r}
searchPath(graph, uniref90 ~ gmm, k = 3)
```

```{r}
# Weave bindings between taxa and GMMs
uniref2gmm <- weaveComplex(graph, uniref90 ~ gmm, init = rownames(genes))

# Print some results
head(uniref2gmm)
```

```{r}
genes <- addModules(genes, uniref2gmm, as = "names")

uniref.modules <- agglomerateByModule(
    genes, by = "rows", group = levels(uniref2gmm$gmm.name)
)

uniref.modules

# miaViz::plotHeatmap
```

## WoL

# Set enrichment analysis

## BugSigDB

```{r}
# Import dataset
data("Tengeler2020", package = "mia")
tse <- Tengeler2020
```

```{r}
searchPath(graph, taxname ~ bugsig)
```

```{r}
tax2bugsig <- weavePath(graph, taxname ~ bugsig, init = rowData(tse)$Genus)

head(tax2bugsig)
```

```{r}
mod.names <- levels(tax2bugsig$bugsig.name)

adhd.mods <- mod.names[grepl("ADHD", mod.names)]

adhd.mods
```


```{r}
tse <- addModules(tse, tax2bugsig, key = "Genus", as = "names")

modules <- agglomerateByModule(tse, by = "rows", group = adhd.mods)

modules
```

```{r}
plotAbundance(modules)
```

# Pathway enrichment analysis

## KEGG

```{r}
searchPath(graph, ec ~ kegg_path, include = "kegg_rxn", k = 3)
```

```{r}
ec2path <- weaveComplex(
    graph,
    ec ~ kegg_path,
    include = "kegg_rxn",
    threshold = 0.5
)

head(ec2path)
```

## MetaCyc

```{r}
searchPath(graph, uniref90 ~ metacyc_path, k = 3)
```

```{r}
uniref2path <- weaveComplex(graph, ec ~ metacyc_path)

head(uniref2path)
```

# Taxonomic translation

With OTT

```{r}
searchPath(graph, taxid ~ silva_ssu)
```

```{r}
taxid2taxname <- weavePath(graph, taxname ~ taxid, init = butyrate$taxname)

knitr::kable(taxid2taxname)
```


```{r}
# or OTT id
taxid2silva <- weavePath(graph, taxid ~ silva_ssu, init = taxid2taxname$taxid)

knitr::kable(taxid2silva)
```
